l.x: 台北 101 雙跨年 主視覺

SPARK 所代表的不僅是一場活動的開始結束，而是串起不同世代、情感與個人記憶的象徵。
在設計上，以中性俐落的無襯線字體展現台北101作為國際地標的姿態，並以中心 A 字的光暈流動作為視覺焦點，象徵火花綻放的瞬間，呼應日夜轉換的情緒節奏，讓 SPARK 的能量從 11 月到隔年 2 月的節慶季節，如同一束光持續閃耀。

SPARK is more than the beginning or end of an event. It is a symbol that connects generations, emotions and personal memories.
In the visual design, a clean and neutral sans-serif typeface expresses the iconic presence of Taipei 101 as an international landmark.
The flowing glow centered on the letter “A” becomes the visual focal point, symbolizing the very moment a spark ignites.
This radiant motion echoes the emotional rhythm between day and night, allowing SPARK’s energy to shine continuously throughout the festive season, from November to February, like a beam of light that never fades.
